# SC-500 Practice Section 3

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-sc-500-question-set-3)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_sc500.svg)

Third practice question set for the **Implementing End-to-End Security Controls for Cloud and AI Workloads (SC-500)** certification exam — the successor to AZ-500. This set approaches the four exam domains from angles that complement Sets 1 and 2: Azure Policy DeployIfNotExists remediation, infrastructure-as-code secret handling, PIM for Groups, Temporary Access Pass onboarding, Conditional Access authentication context, storage encryption scopes, Microsoft Entra-only authentication for Azure SQL, Cosmos DB data-plane RBAC, Application Gateway WAF tuning, Azure Firewall Premium IDPS with TLS inspection, Network Watcher diagnostics, Microsoft Entra Private Access, Azure Functions and Logic Apps hardening, Defender CSPM secrets scanning and custom security standards, Sentinel syslog collection, archived-data search jobs and restore, and AI security governance (Copilot agent management in the Microsoft 365 admin center, Entra Agent ID lifecycle, Copilot Studio DLP hardening, AI Gateway rollout in API Management, SharePoint oversharing remediation, and AI security posture management).

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** — 12 case-study linked + 24 standalone; single choice, multiple choice, ordering, and matching
- **Topics**:
  - Manage Identity, Access, and Governance (20–25%)
  - Secure Storage, Databases, and Networking (25–30%)
  - Secure Compute, including Security for AI (20–25%)
  - Manage and Monitor Security Posture (20–25%)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **security configuration and design decisions** for cloud and AI workloads. It does not cover penetration testing techniques, detailed KQL query authoring, or click-by-click portal walkthroughs. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of Azure and Microsoft security concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.
